title: Chapter 19
text:
At dawn, the Black Harrier helicopter finally arrived. The leader, Hella, and the rest of the team arrived at the place where the test subjects had been wiped out.

Glancing at No. 1's twisted corpse, the leader let out a dissatisfied snort under his mask.

"Trash."

The researcher moved the test subjects' corpses together and said, "They're all dead."

With his hands behind his back, the leader gazed into the distance. After a long silence, he said, "In the name of the Germinal Organization, issue a bounty on No. 0 on the Dark Net. Regardless of life or death, the bounty is one million!"

Everyone was shocked. The Germinal Organization was a giant crocodile, the king of the underground world. They had not issued a bounty in at least three years. Why would they make such a big fuss over a test subject who had defected?

"You seem to value him too much. No. 0 can't even escape in time. What harm can he do to the organization?"

"Hmph, since he dares to declare war on the organization, we'll let him know his own insignificance and destroy his laughable determination!" the leader said coldly.

"If No. 0 is captured alive, no matter what methods you use, be it interrogation or experiment, find out the reason for No. 0's mutation. Even if he dies, his corpse will be dissected for research!"

The researcher pointed at No. 1's corpse and asked, "What about these people?"

The leader was about to say throw them away when he suddenly thought of something and asked, "How are the preparations for the Super Soldier Project going?"

"The basic theory has been perfected. The next step is to carry out cell and animal tests. It is estimated that we can begin human experiments in eight months without any sequelae."

The leader interrupted. "Skip the cell and animal tests. Go straight to human experiments."

"Erm … The risk is high. Only Valkyrie test subjects can withstand the transformation. Test subjects are not easy to come by. Bringing the schedule forward will cause unnecessary losses."

The leader said in an unfathomable tone. "Experiments can only create cannon fodder. Only hatred can create a real demon."

He pointed at Number One. "He is the best raw material. Hatred will drive him to endure the painful transformation. Hatred will be his power furnace."

"I understand." The researcher nodded.

The leader looked at Hella and said, "Summon the spirit."

Hella exhaled a mouthful of turbid air. Her hands glowed with a faint grey light, and the surrounding temperature seemed to drop by ten degrees in an instant.

Faint cries came from Hella's palms. They sounded like the cries of ghosts.

Number One's body seemed to resonate. Strands of drifting gray fog appeared in the air and gently seeped into Number One's bleeding facial features as if they were being absorbed.

The leader opened his windbreaker and took out a tube of bright red medicine from his pocket. Hella's expression changed slightly. Killing intent appeared in her eyes, but she immediately suppressed it.

Aurora Resurrection Potion.

She had extracted her sister's bone marrow and refined it into a super effective healing potion!

The test tube was tipped over and the medicine was poured onto No.1's body. The red liquid instantly dispersed and drilled into the skin through the pores.

A miraculous change occurred. Number One's body, which was already cold, regained its temperature. His wounds healed rapidly, his jaw reconnected, and his broken limbs began to grow flesh.

The sound of his heartbeat gradually grew louder.

Number One suddenly opened his eyes. His face was twisted with malice as he let out a shrill roar filled with monstrous hatred, causing the hair of those who heard it to stand on end.

"Zero!"

…

You have activated the Germinal Organization faction connection!

Favorability of the Germinal Organization decreased by 1,000 points.

Germinal Organization: Hatred (-1,000) – [Traitor]

System Notification: You have triggered the Grade A Mission [Dust of the Fallen Seeds].

Mission Notification: Freedom is priceless. For this, you were willing to take the risk of death and finally received freedom in return. However, the Germinal Organization will not tolerate your betrayal. They have issued a bounty, and you will face endless pursuit. You will never be able to live in peace! This is a disguised cage, a gray sky. If you want to obtain true freedom, there is only one way out. You know what to do!

Mission Notification: This is a long-term mission. The mission reward depends on the progress of your destruction of the Germinal Organization (direct or indirect). Current Progress: 0%.

Note: The progress is not fixed. If the Germinal Organization expands and develops, the progress will decrease accordingly. This mission can be terminated at any time. When the mission is completed, if the progress is less than 20%, it will be considered a failure. If the progress is more than 20%, the mission will be considered complete. The reward depends on the final progress.

Generally speaking, Grade B and above missions were related to the change of power on the current planet. In Version 1.0 of Blue Star, the main event was the conflict between the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization. The players were also divided into different factions.

According to Han Xiao's memory, there were quite a number of players who chose to join the Germinal Organization, providing a huge boost to the organization's development. If he wanted to obtain a high reward, he would have to become an enemy of the players who chose to join the Germinal Organization in the future.

This mission required Han Xiao to directly or indirectly destroy the Germinal Organization. In the original space-time, although the Germinal Organization did not win or lose, they did suffer heavy losses. He realized that there were potential competitors for this mission, and that was the other forces that were enemies of the Germinal Organization. Naturally, the damage that these forces dealt to the Germinal Organization would not be counted in his mission progress.

Twenty percent destruction! Wouldn't that mean that his damage alone would be enough to hurt the Germinal Organization? There was no other way to describe it other than to describe it.

Although this mission was a huge trap, Han Xiao accepted it without hesitation. He and the Germinal Organization were mortal enemies, so there was no reason to reject it.

"Looks like this is my temporary main storyline mission."

The Germinal Organization was the main storyline of Blue Star in Version 1.0. Before Han Xiao grew up, he would stay in Blue Star, so there was no avoiding the conflict between factions.

When a new character was created in Galaxy, the system would ask the player about their preferences, such as what kind of world they liked and what kind of class they liked. Based on the results of the questionnaire, the system would assign the new player to a random novice planet of different styles. Galaxy had a variety of civilizations, and players could always start with their favorite world. Ancient, magical, urban, sci-fi … every planet had one or a few main storyline events.

This was one of the attractions of the game. There was no lack of casual players who liked to explore the universe and try out different civilizations and planets.

Blue Star was one of the novice planets that had a low sci-fi level, similar to Earth.

Of course, the core worldview of Galaxy was still the universe. As the game leveled up, the overall worldview would be gradually revealed to the players.

There were also some players with a bad taste who would give a bad answer when asked by the system, such as "horror", "supernatural", and "haunted". For such people, the system would also use bad taste to satisfy their bad taste. For example, if they were thrown to a planet full of ghosts and ghosts, there would be no place to learn how to deal with ghosts and ghosts, there would be two outcomes for these players. The first was to change their account, and the second … they could only brace themselves and continue playing. The second was to pray for the best. Galaxy's gaming cabin was immersive. Apart from the pain, the experience was extremely realistic. In the game registration disclaimer that most people did not read, it clearly stated that if the player felt uncomfortable during the game, causing physical or mental illness, the company would not be responsible.

In fact, Han Xiao could find a very secluded spot in the wilderness and hide there until the Germinal Organization was greatly weakened. However, this way, he would not be able to grow. Although it was safe, it was meaningless, and he would definitely be overtaken by the players.

Following the main storyline of the planet could trigger a large number of missions. The turbulent world was the best opportunity for growth. Countless events were clear in his mind, so how could he choose to avoid them?

…

It took Han Xiao three days to walk out of the forest, which was within the borders of Stardragon. He had to admit that the Germinal Organization was really bold to have built a base in the heart of Stardragon. They were well aware of the principle of darkness under the light.

After walking out of the forest, Han Xiao found the railway and boarded a long-distance train to transport livestock to Stardragon's capital, the West Capital.

Due to the dangerous environment in the wilderness, as well as the undercurrents between the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization, most of the roads connecting the cities had been abandoned. The military had used the railway to connect the cities to transport supplies.

The wild beasts were strong, so every city had an army stationed and built a sentry post. Tall, electrified iron barriers were the first line of defense of the city. Generally, when one saw the iron fence, one would know that the city was not far away.

After two days of 'free' riding, the silhouette of the electrified iron fence finally appeared in the distance.

Han Xiao pushed away a few hens that were jumping on his body. He took a deep breath and looked into the distance.

Stardragon, West Capital, Division 13, here I come!
